summary: The code is syntactically correct and runs with a direct main() call. It implements an agent-based mask adoption simulation with social influence, media, and a simple retail market, including calibration scaffolding. However, it diverges significantly from the specified task: required entities (Location, PolicyMaker with specified attributes), interactions (policy enforcement at locations, mobility), parameters, and several metrics are missing or renamed. Some logic details are simplified or inconsistent (no mask consumption, misnamed observables). Error handling and performance are acceptable for the given scale.

issues.description: Missing Location entity and associated attributes/behaviors (host_agents_and_interactions, check_and_enforce_mask_requirement), preventing implementation of mobility_and_presence and policy_enforcement interactions.
issues.location: No Location dataclass or module; interactions not present across modules
issues.solution: Introduce a Location dataclass with fields (id, type, capacity, region_id, mask_requirement, enforcement_level) and a module to handle attendance schedules, hosting interactions, and enforcing mask requirements with fines/evictions. Integrate mobility schedules for Person agents.

issues.description: PolicyMaker entity as specified is absent. A Government class exists but does not expose all required attributes/behaviors (issue_or_update_mask_mandate, adjust_enforcement_based_on_outcomes).
issues.solution: Add a PolicyMaker dataclass with attributes (mandate_active, mandate_strictness, enforcement_probability, fine_amount, communication_intensity) and behaviors. Extend GovernmentPolicyModule to update mandates dynamically, adjust enforcement, and broadcast info campaigns.

issues.description: Person attributes diverge from spec: missing age_group, workplace_id, social_neighbors (different name), mask_adoption_state (uses adoption_state), compliance_propensity present but unused, trust_in_authorities vs trust_in_peers missing, perceived_benefit/cost not explicit, mask_quality_owned missing, budget missing, awareness_level missing.
issues.location: Person dataclass and modules using it
issues.solution: Align Person dataclass to include all specified attributes and use them in decision logic: compute perceived_benefit/cost, incorporate trust_in_peers and authorities, maintain budget, and track mask_quality_owned and awareness_level.

issues.description: Retailer entity attributes diverge: missing region_id, mask_inventory (uses inventory_level), quality_mix; behaviors do not include dynamic price adjustment based on supply/demand.
issues.solution: Refactor Retailer to match attributes (region_id, mask_inventory, mask_price, restock_rate, quality_mix). Implement adjust_price_based_on_supply_demand and track quality inventory and sales.

issues.description: Several required interactions are unimplemented: policy_enforcement at locations, mobility_and_presence (attendance schedules), and market_transaction constraints with per-person budgets and subsidies.
issues.location: Overall module set; missing mobility/enforcement modules
issues.solution: Add modules for mobility (daily schedules mapping persons to locations), enforcement at locations applying mandates (probabilistic enforcement and fines), and budget-aware purchasing with subsidies and price sensitivity.

issues.description: Parameters diverge from specification: keys like time_horizon_days, seed_adopters_fraction, baseline_adoption_prob, risk_perception_sensitivity, perceived_prevalence_signal, perceived_cost_sensitivity, trust_in_authorities_mean, trust_in_peers_mean, compliance_decay_rate, observation_noise, location_mix are not present or unused. Uses custom names (simulation_horizon_days, etc.).
issues.solution: Adopt the specified parameter names and wire them into modules. Provide backward-compatible aliases if needed, but ensure the specified keys drive behavior.

issues.description: Metrics required by spec missing or mismatched: final_adoption_rate, compliance_by_location_type, inequality_of_adoption (Gini or CV), violation_rate, average_mask_quality are not computed.
issues.solution: Compute and store: adoption_rate_over_time, final_adoption_rate (last day), time_to_threshold, mandate_effect_size (difference across counterfactuals), compliance_by_location_type from location attendance, inequality_of_adoption via Gini/CV across subgroups/regions, violation_rate at mandate-required locations, and average_mask_quality weighted by usage.

issues.description: Adoption decision and inventory handling do not consume masks when worn nor degrade quality; purchases do not affect a per-agent budget; compliance_propensity and social_influence_susceptibility are not used.
issues.solution: Deduct mask inventory upon use and model decay/replacement; implement a budget per agent and deduct expenditures; incorporate compliance_propensity and social_influence_susceptibility in the logistic decision probability.

issues.description: Observables naming mismatch: AdoptionDecisionModule records 'adoption_intent_daily' but sets it to the number of wearers (wore_count), not intent to purchase.
issues.solution: Rename to 'wearers_daily' or compute and record a separate 'purchase_intent_daily' as the number of agents with intent_to_purchase=True.

issues.description: Information reach metric counts only credible exposures rather than total reach.
issues.solution: Compute reach as the fraction of agents who saw any media (saw_media), independent of credibility/misinformation classification.

issues.description: Scale-free graph generator uses linear scan for preferential attachment, leading to O(n*m*n) behavior for sampling targets.
issues.solution: Use a cumulative degree array with binary search or alias sampling, or maintain a 'repeated node list' method to sample in O(1) expected time per edge.

issues.description: Some functions include 'pass' statements after returns; harmless but unnecessary.
issues.solution: Remove trailing 'pass' statements after return to clean up the code.
